newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Rate on 91-day Cyprus bills steady at 5.50 pct.
newsitem.headline: Rate on 91-day Cyprus bills steady at 5.50 pct.

text.p: The average yield on a central bank treasury auction of 91 day bills was 5.502 percent on Wednesday, steady on the yield of the last auction held on May 14, the central bank said.

Competitive bids for bills worth 18 million pounds ($35.4 million) were made for the 15 million pounds worth initially put on offer by the central bank. It accepted bids worth 12 million with yields ranging from 5.498 percent to 5.502 percent. ($ = 0.509 Cyprus Pounds)
